raw_graphql_pull_request.body:
## Motivation

On MI355X, Qwen3.5-397B-A17B-FP8 decode at low concurrency runs two latency-bound kernels for each dense FP8 projection: AITER's 1x128 activation quant (about 4 µs) and the block-scale GEMM (about 9 µs). EAGLE with four draft tokens runs these projections at 4 to 32 tokens per rank for concurrency 1 to 8.

This PR fuses them into one HIP kernel for M ≤ 32 at the TP4 and TP8 shapes; larger inputs and other shapes keep the AITER path. With the InferenceX recipe, interactivity improves by 5 to 10% at TP8 and about 3% at TP4.

## Modifications

- New `python/sglang/kernels/ops/gemm/smallm_fp8_blockscale_gfx950/`: one HIP kernel that quantizes bf16 activations to fp8 in registers (1x128 groups, bit-exact with `aiter_per1x128_quant`) and runs the block-scale GEMM on the existing AITER-preshuffled weight and `weight_scale_inv`, so weight loading is untouched. It is built with `hipcc` on first use through the `smallm_moe_gfx950` helpers (#40204), with no build or wheel change.
- `SHAPES` covers the Qwen3.5-397B-A17B dense FP8 projections up to M = 32:

  | (N, K) | TP | Layer |
  |---|---|---|
  | (5120, 4096) | 4 | GDN `in_proj_qkvz` |
  | (4608, 4096) | 4 | attention `qkv_proj` |
  | (4096, 2048) | 4 | GDN `out_proj`, attention `o_proj` |
  | (2560, 4096) | 8 | GDN `in_proj_qkvz`, attention `qkv_proj` |
  | (4096, 1024) | 8 | GDN `out_proj`, attention `o_proj` |

- `fp8_utils.py`: `aiter_w8a8_block_fp8_linear` calls `try_smallm_fp8_bs_linear` on the gfx950 bpreshuffle path when the input is not pre-quantized and there is no bias (+8 lines). It returns `None`, and AITER runs, for any shape, M, dtype, or layout it does not support. `SGLANG_ROCM_SMALLM_FP8_BS=0` turns it off.
- Tests (MI35x suite): `test_smallm_fp8_blockscale_gfx950.py` matches AITER at M = 1 to 32 on all five shapes, checks the quant is bit-exact, covers the fallback cases (M = 33, fp16, unaligned rows, unshuffled weight, off switch), and checks graph replay against eager.

## Accuracy Tests

All runs use image `rocm/sgl-dev:v0.5.20-rocm720-mi35x-20260927`, InferenceX recipe flags with real draft acceptance, `sglang.test.few_shot_gsm8k`, 1319 questions. `--max-running-requests 8` keeps every verify pass at 32 tokens or fewer, so all dense FP8 projections take the new kernel. "main" is the image's tree (main at `a0ba1968b1`); baseline is the same tree with `SGLANG_ROCM_SMALLM_FP8_BS=0`.

| Model | Tree | Baseline | This PR |
|---|---|---:|---:|
| `Qwen/Qwen3.5-397B-A17B-FP8` TP4 | main, 2 runs | 0.958 / 0.955 | 0.952 / 0.951 |
| | Mean of 2 runs | 0.957 | 0.952 |
| `Qwen/Qwen3.5-397B-A17B-FP8` TP8 | main, 2 runs | 0.951 / 0.949 | 0.963 / 0.943 |
| | Mean of 2 runs | 0.950 | 0.953 |

One run's standard error at 1319 questions is about 0.006.

## Benchmarking and Profiling

### Kernel microbenchmarks

MI355X, one GPU, CUDA graph replay, weights rotated over 24 copies so they are not cache resident. AITER `aiter_per1x128_quant` + `gemm_a8w8_blockscale_bpreshuffle` (tuned Qwen3.5 config) vs this kernel, in µs.

TP4 shapes:

| Tokens | `in_proj_qkvz` 5120 x 4096 | `qkv_proj` 4608 x 4096 | `out_proj` / `o_proj` 4096 x 2048 |
|---:|---:|---:|---:|
| 1 | 13.7 → 6.8 (−51%) | 13.7 → 6.6 (−51%) | 6.8 → 4.0 (−42%) |
| 4 | 15.8 → 7.3 (−54%) | 15.8 → 7.0 (−56%) | 8.8 → 4.1 (−54%) |
| 8 | 16.0 → 7.7 (−52%) | 16.0 → 7.8 (−51%) | 8.8 → 4.2 (−53%) |
| 16 | 16.5 → 9.0 (−46%) | 16.6 → 8.3 (−50%) | 9.0 → 4.7 (−48%) |
| 32 (cap) | 16.8 → 12.8 (−24%) | 16.7 → 12.6 (−24%) | 10.0 → 7.7 (−23%) |

TP8 shapes:

| Tokens | `in_proj_qkvz` / `qkv_proj` 2560 x 4096 | `out_proj` / `o_proj` 4096 x 1024 |
|---:|---:|---:|
| 1 | 12.8 → 5.2 (−60%) | 5.7 → 3.2 (−44%) |
| 4 | 14.6 → 5.6 (−62%) | 7.3 → 3.3 (−54%) |
| 8 | 15.2 → 6.0 (−60%) | 7.6 → 3.3 (−57%) |
| 16 | 14.9 → 7.3 (−51%) | 7.6 → 3.4 (−55%) |
| 32 (cap) | 15.2 → 11.3 (−26%) | 8.2 → 4.9 (−40%) |

Max relative difference to AITER over all TP4 points is 3.1e-3; the quantized activations are bit-exact on all five shapes.

### Decode step time

Time for one EAGLE draft + verify cycle at a fixed batch size. MI355X TP4, image `rocm/sgl-dev:v0.5.20-rocm720-mi35x-20260927`, InferenceX recipe flags without `--enable-aiter-allreduce-fusion` (FP8 KV cache, EAGLE 3 / 1 / 4 with simulated acceptance 3.39). Mean of two runs with the GPU sets swapped, in ms:

| Batch size | Verify tokens | Baseline | This PR | Change |
|---:|---:|---:|---:|---:|
| 1 | 4 | 11.93 | 11.10 | −7% |
| 4 | 16 | 16.53 | 15.86 | −4% |
| 8 | 32 | 16.29 | 16.22 | ~0 (at the cap) |

### AgentX benchmark

- Hardware: MI355X, TP4 and TP8.
- Model and recipe: `Qwen/Qwen3.5-397B-A17B-FP8` with the InferenceX recipe `qwen3.5-fp8-mi355x-sglang-agentic`, image `rocm/sgl-dev:v0.5.20-rocm720-mi35x-20260927`.
- Server flags: as in the recipe, including `--enable-aiter-allreduce-fusion`. FP8 KV cache, EAGLE 3 / 1 / 4 with simulated acceptance 3.39, admission and decode CUDA graph batch at 2x concurrency. The recipe has no TP8 point, so TP8 uses the same flags with `--tensor-parallel-size 8`.
- Client: the CI AgentX command, `aiperf profile --scenario inferencex-agentx-mvp` on `semianalysis_cc_traces_weka_062126_256k`, 3600 s per run.
- Baseline is the same tree with `SGLANG_ROCM_SMALLM_FP8_BS=0`.

TP8, concurrency 1:

| Metric | Baseline | This PR | Change |
|---|---:|---:|---:|
| TPOT p50 / p90 (ms) | 3.61 / 4.08 | 3.32 / 3.88 | −8% / −5% |
| TTFT p50 / p90 (ms) | 353 / 832 | 377 / 894 | +7% / +7% |
| Requests completed in 3600 s | 557 | 578 | +4% |
| Output throughput (tok/s) | 150 | 162 | +8% |
| Interactivity p50 / p90 (tok/s/user) | 277 / 301 | 301 / 332 | +9% / +10% |

TP8, concurrency 4:

| Metric | Baseline | This PR | Change |
|---|---:|---:|---:|
| TPOT p50 / p90 (ms) | 4.10 / 4.97 | 3.90 / 4.65 | −5% / −6% |
| TTFT p50 / p90 (ms) | 514 / 957 | 509 / 969 | −1% / +1% |
| Requests completed in 3600 s | 936 | 928 | −1% |
| Output throughput (tok/s) | 245 | 242 | −1% |
| Interactivity p50 / p90 (tok/s/user) | 244 / 291 | 257 / 314 | +5% / +8% |

TP8, concurrency 8:

| Metric | Baseline | This PR | Change |
|---|---:|---:|---:|
| TPOT p50 / p90 (ms) | 4.74 / 5.50 | 4.53 / 5.35 | −4% / −3% |
| TTFT p50 / p90 (ms) | 723 / 1197 | 691 / 1158 | −4% / −3% |
| Requests completed in 3600 s | 1449 | 1456 | ~0 |
| Output throughput (tok/s) | 372 | 373 | ~0 |
| Interactivity p50 / p90 (tok/s/user) | 211 / 275 | 221 / 298 | +5% / +8% |

TP4, concurrency 1:

| Metric | Baseline | This PR | Change |
|---|---:|---:|---:|
| TPOT p50 / p90 (ms) | 2.94 / 3.22 | 2.84 / 3.11 | −3% / −3% |
| TTFT p50 / p90 (ms) | 355 / 843 | 357 / 836 | ~0 / −1% |
| Requests completed in 3600 s | 633 | 635 | ~0 |
| Output throughput (tok/s) | 178 | 178 | ~0 |
| Interactivity p50 / p90 (tok/s/user) | 340 / 357 | 352 / 368 | +3% / +3% |

TP4, concurrency 4:

| Metric | Baseline | This PR | Change |
|---|---:|---:|---:|
| TPOT p50 / p90 (ms) | 3.17 / 4.24 | 3.07 / 4.05 | −3% / −4% |
| TTFT p50 / p90 (ms) | 501 / 913 | 505 / 912 | +1% / ~0 |
| Requests completed in 3600 s | 1011 | 1026 | +1% |
| Output throughput (tok/s) | 274 | 278 | +2% |
| Interactivity p50 / p90 (tok/s/user) | 315 / 349 | 325 / 361 | +3% / +3% |

With `--enable-aiter-allreduce-fusion`, the fused all-reduce + RMSNorm already quantizes the input of `in_proj_qkvz` and `qkv_proj` to FP8, so those layers keep the AITER GEMM. The kernel runs on `out_proj` / `o_proj` in every layer, the first layer's `in_proj_qkvz`, and the MTP layer's `qkv_proj`. At TP8 those projections are a larger share of each decode step, so the gain is larger than at TP4. Each EAGLE verify pass sends 4 tokens per running request through every projection, so the kernel covers running batches of 8 or fewer. The kernel does not run in prefill.

nodes.body:
@chuyeh  
Failed checks:
1. AMD Guard
   The diff imports AITER, but the code-path scope is gfx950 bpreshuffle path (_use_aiter_bpreshuffle_gfx95); the kernel is compiled with --offload-arch=gfx950.
   Required: Gate the AITER import with _use_aiter. is_hip alone crashes on an AMD machine that does not have AITER installed.
2. PR body
   Score 6/10. The first sentence gives token counts. MI355X and the 1.6 ms decode cycle come later, after the kernel names, so the machine and the slowdown do not connect on one read.
   Required: Improve PR body (motivation mainly, added a one line action you did in this PR as conclusion) 
   Example: On MI355X, Qwen3.5-397B-A17B-FP8 decode at concurrency 1 spends 1.6 to 1.7 ms per cycle in the dense FP8 projections. EAGLE with 4 draft tokens runs each projection at 4 to 32 tokens per rank, from concurrency 1 to 8. Each projection is two latency-bound kernels, about 4 µs then 9 µs.

**CI note:** The [Base CPU failure](https://github.com/sgl-project/sglang/actions/runs/37728450055/job/113152412526?pr=42229) is unrelated to this PR. The NPU test added by [#40404](https://github.com/sgl-project/sglang/pull/40404) constructs `NPUCudaGraphBackend` without publishing `tp_group`, causing:

`RuntimeError: parallel name 'tp_group' has not been written in this process`

This PR only changes the gfx950 FP8/HIP path. I will trigger fresh CI against updated `main` after the upstream NPU test fix is merged.
Affect gfx950 only for qwen3.5 fp8 agent mode low concurrency, looks good to me.

files.patch:
@@ -0,0 +1,72 @@
+"""gfx950 small-M FP8 block-scale GEMM with fused activation quant."""
+
+import ctypes
+import os
+import subprocess
+import tempfile
+
+import torch
+
+from sglang.kernels.ops.moe.smallm_moe_gfx950 import _check, _hip_lib, _hipcc, _Kernel
+
+_SRC = os.path.join(os.path.dirname(__file__), "smallm_fp8_blockscale_gemm.hip")
+# (N, K) -> (max M, N tiles/block, K steps/wave, waves), first match wins.
+SHAPES = {
+    (5120, 4096): ((32, 2, 4, 16),),
+    (4608, 4096): ((32, 2, 4, 16),),
+    (4096, 2048): ((8, 1, 4, 8), (16, 1, 2, 16), (32, 1, 4, 8)),
+    (2560, 4096): ((32, 1, 4, 16),),
+    (4096, 1024): ((32, 1, 2, 8),),
+}
+_mod = None
+_fns = {}
+
+
+class Args(ctypes.Structure):
+    _fields_ = [(n, ctypes.c_void_p) for n in ("x", "w", "ws", "out")] + [
+        (n, ctypes.c_int32) for n in ("M", "N", "lda")
+    ]
+
+
+def try_smallm_fp8_bs_linear(x, WQ, w_scale):
+    """Run the fused kernel, or return None for fallback."""
+    global _mod
+    (M, K), N = x.shape, WQ.shape[0]
+    cfg = next((cfg for max_m, *cfg in SHAPES.get((N, K), ()) if M <= max_m), None)
+    if not (
+        _mod is not False

+        except (OSError, subprocess.CalledProcessError, RuntimeError) as e:

+import os
+import unittest
+from unittest import mock
+
+import torch
+
+from sglang.kernels.ops.gemm import smallm_fp8_blockscale_gfx950 as B
+from sglang.srt.layers.quantization import fp8_utils
+from sglang.test.ci.ci_register import register_amd_ci
+from sglang.test.test_utils import CustomTestCase
+
+register_amd_ci(est_time=20, suite="stage-b-test-1-gpu-small-amd-mi35x")
+
+SHAPES = [(5120, 4096), (4608, 4096), (4096, 2048), (2560, 4096), (4096, 1024)]
+MS = (1, 3, 4, 8, 9, 16, 17, 24, 32)
+
+
+def _x(m, k):
+    # per-group magnitudes differ so every 128-wide group gets its own scale
+    g = torch.rand(m, k // 128, 1, device="cuda") * 8
+    return (torch.randn(m, k // 128, 128, device="cuda") * g).view(m, k).bfloat16()
+
+
+def _w(w):
+    from aiter.ops.shuffle import shuffle_weight
+
+    wq = shuffle_weight(w.to(torch.float8_e4m3fn), (16, 16))
+    wq.is_shuffled = True
+    return wq
+
+
+@unittest.skipUnless(
+    torch.version.hip
+    and fp8_utils._use_aiter_bpreshuffle_gfx95
+    and torch.cuda.is_available()
+    and torch.cuda.get_device_properties(0).gcnArchName.startswith("gfx950"),
+    "gfx950 (MI35x) with AITER bpreshuffle only",
+)
+class TestSmallMFp8BlockscaleGfx950(CustomTestCase):
+    def setUp(self):
+        torch.manual_seed(0)
+
+    def test_matches_aiter(self):
+        from aiter import gemm_a8w8_blockscale_bpreshuffle as gemm
+
+        materialize = fp8_utils.materialize_bpreshuffle_fp8_scale
+        q = fp8_utils.aiter_per1x128_quant
+
+        for n, k in SHAPES:
+            wq = _w(torch.randn(n, k, device="cuda") * 0.5)
+            ws = torch.rand(n // 128, k // 128, device="cuda") * 1e-2 + 1e-3
+            for m in MS:
+                x = _x(m, k)
+                xq, xs = q(x, quant_dtype=torch.float8_e4m3fn, transpose_scale=False)
+                ref = gemm(xq, wq, materialize(xs), ws, dtype=torch.bfloat16)
+                out = B.try_smallm_fp8_bs_linear(x, wq, ws)
+                torch.testing.assert_close(out, ref, atol=2e-2, rtol=2e-2)
+
+    def test_quant_bit_exact(self):
+        # one-hot weights, unit scales: out[m, n] = bf16(q[m, k] * xs[m, k // 128])
+        q = fp8_utils.aiter_per1x128_quant
+        for n, k in SHAPES:
+            col = torch.arange(n, device="cuda") % k
+            wq = _w(torch.nn.functional.one_hot(col, k).float())
+            ws = torch.ones(n // 128, k // 128, device="cuda")
+            for m in MS:
+                x = _x(m, k)
+                xq, xs = q(x, quant_dtype=torch.float8_e4m3fn, transpose_scale=False)
+                ref = (xq.float() * xs.repeat_interleave(128, 1))[:, col].bfloat16()
+                out = B.try_smallm_fp8_bs_linear(x, wq, ws)
+                self.assertTrue(torch.equal(out, ref), f"{n=} {m=}")
+
+    def test_fallback(self):
+        wq = _w(torch.zeros(4096, 2048, device="cuda"))
+        ws = torch.ones(32, 16, device="cuda")
+        x = _x(4, 2048)
+        unaligned = torch.randn(4, 2052, device="cuda").bfloat16()[:, :2048]
+        for bad_x, bad_w in (
+            (_x(33, 2048), wq),
+            (x.half(), wq),
+            (unaligned, wq),
+            (x, wq.view(torch.uint8).view(wq.dtype)),
+        ):
+            self.assertIsNone(B.try_smallm_fp8_bs_linear(bad_x, bad_w, ws))
+        with mock.patch.dict(os.environ, {"SGLANG_ROCM_SMALLM_FP8_BS": "0"}):
+            self.assertIsNone(B.try_smallm_fp8_bs_linear(x, wq, ws))
+
+    def test_graph_replay(self):
+        wq = _w(torch.randn(5120, 4096, device="cuda") * 0.5)
+        ws = torch.rand(40, 32, device="cuda") * 1e-2
+        x = _x(4, 4096)
+        eager = B.try_smallm_fp8_bs_linear(x, wq, ws)
+        g = torch.cuda.CUDAGraph()
+        with torch.cuda.graph(g):
+            out = B.try_smallm_fp8_bs_linear(x, wq, ws)
+        g.replay()
+        torch.cuda.synchronize()
+        self.assertTrue(torch.equal(out, eager))
+
+
+if __name__ == "__main__":
+    unittest.main()

@chuyeh  
Failed checks:
1. AMD Guard
   The diff imports AITER, but the code-path scope is gfx950 bpreshuffle path (_use_aiter_bpreshuffle_gfx95); the kernel is compiled with --offload-arch=gfx950.
   Required: Gate the AITER import with _use_aiter. is_hip alone crashes on an AMD machine that does not have AITER installed.
2. PR body
   Score 6/10. The first sentence gives token counts. MI355X and the 1.6 ms decode cycle come later, after the kernel names, so the machine and the slowdown do not connect on one read.
   Required: Improve PR body (motivation mainly, added a one line action you did in this PR as conclusion) 
   Example: On MI355X, Qwen3.5-397B-A17B-FP8 decode at concurrency 1 spends 1.6 to 1.7 ms per cycle in the dense FP8 projections. EAGLE with 4 draft tokens runs each projection at 4 to 32 tokens per rank, from concurrency 1 to 8. Each projection is two latency-bound kernels, about 4 µs then 9 µs.

**CI note:** The [Base CPU failure](https://github.com/sgl-project/sglang/actions/runs/37728450055/job/113152412526?pr=42229) is unrelated to this PR. The NPU test added by [#40404](https://github.com/sgl-project/sglang/pull/40404) constructs `NPUCudaGraphBackend` without publishing `tp_group`, causing:

`RuntimeError: parallel name 'tp_group' has not been written in this process`

This PR only changes the gfx950 FP8/HIP path. I will trigger fresh CI against updated `main` after the upstream NPU test fix is merged.
